meta.title: Sign in
meta.description: Sign in to your Soulwick game: with Google, Apple, Discord, Steam or by e-mail.

noScript: Signing in needs JavaScript. Turn it on for this page and open the link from the game again.
validFor: {minutes, plural, =0 {Expires in less than a minute.} one {Valid for # more minute.} other {Valid for # more minutes.}}

pending.leadSignIn: Your game is waiting. Pick how you want to sign in, then we ask for the code your game shows.
pending.leadLink: You're adding a sign-in to your account. With it you get into this account on every device.
pending.warningTitle: Did you just start this in the game yourself?
pending.warning: Only go on if you did. If someone sent you this link, close the page – otherwise they play with your account.
pending.methodsTitle: How do you want to sign in?
pending.noMethods: None of these ways is switched on here right now. Sign in right in the game or try again later.
pending.newAccount: New here? We set up an account for you. With Google, Apple, Discord and Steam we only keep an ID, no name and no e-mail address.

email.label: E-mail address
email.hint: We send you a link that works once for {minutes} minutes. No password needed.
email.sentText: If the address is right, your link lands there in a moment. Open it on this or any other device. Nothing there? Look in spam or send it again.

notices.invalid: That doesn't look like an e-mail address.
notices.rate_limited: That was a lot of links. Wait a few minutes and try again.
notices.not_configured: Signing in by e-mail isn't switched on here. Pick another way.
notices.unreachable: We can't reach the Soulwick server right now. Try again in a moment.
notices.closed: This sign-in is already finished or expired. Start again in the game.

confirm.signIn: A game gets signed in to your account
confirm.signInNew: A game gets signed in to a new account
confirm.link: This account gets a new sign-in
confirm.newAccountHint: This sign-in doesn't belong to an account yet. We set one up for you.
confirm.warningTitle: Only go on if you started this yourself just now
confirm.warning: Someone else's game would get your account. Not you? Close this page and nothing happens.
confirm.codeHint: Your game shows it right now: {length} letters and numbers, like ABC-DEF.

notices.format: The code has {length} letters and numbers. Look at your game and type it again.
notices.wrong_code: That's not the code from your game. Look again closely.
notices.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# try left.} other {# tries left.}}
notices.rate_limited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute.
notices.unreachable: We can't reach the Soulwick server right now. Try again in a moment.

confirm.waitingTitle: This sign-in waits for its last step
confirm.waitingText: Finish it in the browser tab where you signed in. Can't find it? Start again in the game.
confirm.absorbHint: Your other account here has no progress yet. It merges into this one.

merge.title: Two accounts become one
merge.lead: This sign-in already belongs to another account with progress. If you go on, both become one.
merge.runs: {count, plural, =0 {No runs} one {# run} other {# runs}}
merge.worlds: {count, plural, =0 {No worlds} one {# world} other {# worlds}}

what.name: The account that stays keeps its name.
what.progress: Runs, XP and sign-ins move over; levels add up.
what.worlds: Worlds move over. If there's no room, they go to the archive, nothing is lost.
what.guilds: Guild memberships move over as long as there's room.

done.title: Done! Back to the game
done.signedIn: Your game is signed in. It continues on its own in a moment, you can close this tab.
done.linked: Your account has a new sign-in. Back in the game it continues on its own, you can close this tab.
done.merged: Your two accounts are one now.

problem.again: Start signing in again in the game. You get a new code.
problem.banPermanent: This ban has no end date.

noKey.title: Open the link right from the game
noKey.text: For your safety this page only works when the game opens it. In the game, choose to sign in in the browser again.

magic.title: Another device gets signed in
magic.textSignIn: This link signs in a Soulwick game – maybe on this device, maybe on another one. Next we ask for the code that game shows.
magic.textLink: This link adds your e-mail address as a sign-in to <account></account>. Next we ask for the code your game shows.
magic.warningTitle: Did you ask for this link yourself just now?
magic.warning: Only go on if you did. If not, close this page and nothing happens.

notices.rate_limited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, the link still works.
notices.unreachable: We can't reach the Soulwick server right now. Try again in a moment, the link still works.

errorPage.title: Sign in from the game
errorPage.text: Signing in starts in your game: choose to sign in in the browser there and this page opens with your code.

web_login_claimed.title: Link already used
web_login_claimed.text: This link from the game was already opened somewhere else.

web_login_not_pending.title: Already finished
web_login_not_pending.text: This sign-in is already done or expired.

expired.title: Code expired
expired.text: Codes are valid for {codeMinutes} minutes and work once.

too_many_attempts.title: Too many wrong codes
too_many_attempts.text: To keep your account safe, this sign-in has ended.

invalid_state.title: Something got mixed up
invalid_state.text: The sign-in didn't come back to the right place, maybe it was opened in another browser.

provider_not_configured.title: Not available here
provider_not_configured.text: This way of signing in isn't switched on here. Pick another one.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.text: You cancelled signing in. No problem, just pick a way again.

provider_error.title: No answer
provider_error.text: Google, Apple, Discord or Steam didn't answer. Try again in a moment or pick another way.

invalid_login.title: That didn't work
invalid_login.text: We couldn't check your sign-in. Try again.

banned.title: Account banned
banned.text: This account is banned and can't be signed in.

merge_blocked_banned.title: Can't merge
merge_blocked_banned.text: One of the two accounts is banned, so they can't become one.

account_gone.title: Account gone
account_gone.text: The account you started this from doesn't exist any more.

email_unavailable.title: Use another address
email_unavailable.text: This e-mail address can't be used for Soulwick. Take another one.

invalid_magic_link.title: Link used or expired
invalid_magic_link.text: Each link works once for {linkMinutes} minutes.

rate_limited.title: Slow down
rate_limited.text: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

unreachable.title: Server not reachable
unreachable.text: We can't reach the Soulwick server right now. Try again in a moment.
